description: RadarJobs connects to a user's existing account to search current U.S. technology jobs across ordinary W-2 employment and contract work, inspect one selected job, and review personalized recommendations. Results include normalized employment details, source evidence, freshness, the actual source posting, and a separate RadarJobs detail link.

defaultPrompt: Find current tech jobs that match my role, location, employment type, and pay preferences.
Show my complete current personalized RadarJobs recommendations.
Find current remote tech jobs and give me full details on the strongest match.
